## Purpose

Describe the focused problem and user-visible behavior change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests were added or updated.
- [ ] Exact positive and negative identities were frozen before candidate output when query behavior changed.
- [ ] Product tests pass with TypeScript integration enabled.
- [ ] Package verification/lifecycle checks pass when packaging changed.
- [ ] Documentation, changelog, limits, and version were updated where required.
- [ ] No credentials, user source, local indexes, absolute machine configuration, or sensitive evaluation output is included.

## Compatibility and risk

Explain data/source mutation, Provider lifecycle, truncation/provenance, security,
privacy, and rollback implications. State unsupported cases explicitly.
